entry.title: The Banks-Holland Partnership — Romantic Partners, Criminal Enterprise, Institutional Control
entry.content:
Summary

Brian Roderick Banks and Joseph Holland Jr. are romantic partners who have operated as a cohabitating domestic and economic unit for at least 20 years. They share a residential address, jointly own real property, co-lead a private foundation, and are connected through a trust that places Holland in control of Banks’ primary asset.

Banks uses Holland. Every financial gatekeeping role in the enterprise — Secretary/Treasurer, PAC Treasurer, Successor Trustee — is filled by his partner. A convicted drug offender, discharged from MDOC without improvement, given custody of public education dollars flowing through a children’s charter school.

This is the documented record of two convicted felons — romantic partners — who together hold every officer and financial position in a network of entities receiving millions in public education funding. Section 5.2 of the Management Agreement (“No Related Parties or Common Control”) is definitively violated.

The Property Chain ✅ Verified

Three properties connect Banks and Holland across two decades:

PropertyOwner(s)Key InstrumentSignificance
21553 Newcastle Rd, Harper WoodsBanks + Holland (JTWRS)Wayne ROD #2007402847 ($1 QCD, Jun 2007)Joint ownership since 2007. Concealed in Holland BK3.
21456 Newcastle Rd, Harper WoodsBanks (prior)Severn warranty deedOne house from 21553. Justin Banks (trustee #2) lists this address.
1968 Severn Rd, Grosse Pointe WoodsBrian Banks Living TrustWayne ROD #2024223261 (QCD Aug 2024)Holland named 1st Successor Trustee (Wayne ROD #2025307266, Nov 2025). HELOC $93,700 (Nov 2025).

Banks grew up one house from Holland on Newcastle Rd. In June 2007, Banks QCD’d 21553 Newcastle to himself and Holland as Joint Tenants with Right of Survivorship — for $1. That property has been jointly owned for 19 years.

The Concealment 📄 Documented

Holland filed five bankruptcies between 2005 and 2014. The critical comparison:

BK1 — Case 09-46072-swr (2009, Ch.13)

ScheduleDisclosure
Schedule A (Real Property)21553 Newcastle Rd — valued at $65,000
Schedule H (Codebtors)Brian Banks listed as codebtor
OutcomeDismissed — “lack of good faith”

BK3 — Case 14-51632-mar (2014, Ch.7)

ScheduleDisclosure
Schedule A (Real Property)“None”
Schedule H (Codebtors)“No codebtors”
Outcome$110,305 discharged

The $1 JTWRS deed (#2007402847) remained on file at the Wayne County Register of Deeds throughout both proceedings. Holland swore under penalty of perjury that he owned no real property and had no codebtors. The deed proving otherwise was one public records search away.

This is 18 U.S.C. § 152 — concealment of assets in bankruptcy and false oath in bankruptcy.

The Trust Structure ✅ Verified

In August 2024, Banks transferred his primary residence (1968 Severn Rd, Grosse Pointe Woods) into the Brian Banks Living Trust:

DateInstrumentAction
Aug 2024Wayne ROD #2024223261QCD: Banks → Brian Banks Living Trust
Nov 7, 2025Wayne ROD #2025307266Trust Certificate: Holland named 1st Successor Trustee
Nov 2025Wayne ROD #2025307267HELOC: $93,700 against 1968 Severn

If Banks dies, becomes incapacitated, or faces a judgment, Holland controls the asset. The trust was created six months after Holland’s MDOC discharge (“WITHOUT IMPROVEMENT”) and one year before the litigation began.

The Entity Structure ✅ Verified

Banks and Holland together hold every position at multiple entities:

EntityBanks’ RoleHolland’s RoleAddress
Purpose Foundation (LARA 803294855)President + DirectorSecretary + Treasurer1968 Severn Rd
Purpose Group LLC (LARA 803295082)Sole Member—1968 Severn Rd
Banks Strategy LLC (LARA 802070120)Sole Member—1968 Severn Rd
Bank on Banks PAC (#517977)—Treasurer1968 Severn Rd
Brian Banks Living TrustSettlor/Trustee1st Successor Trustee1968 Severn Rd

Every entity. Same two people. Same home address. Zero independent oversight.

What This Means for Public Schools 📄 Documented

Purpose Group LLC — of which Banks is the sole member — takes 72.67% of MacDowell Preparatory Academy’s revenue ($3,936,712 of $4,929,893). The management agreement (Section 5.2) states there are “No Related Parties or Common Control” between Purpose Group and Purpose Charter Academy.

Banks is the sole member of Purpose Group AND the superintendent of PCA. Holland — his romantic partner, co-owner, and successor trustee — holds the financial positions. That clause is violated on its face. They are not just related parties — they are lovers sharing a home, finances, and every entity in the network. The “No Related Parties” representation is a lie signed by a convicted felon about his convicted drug offender partner.

These are public schools funded with public money, educating Detroit children. Parents have a right to know who controls the money.

The Tax Lien ✅ Verified

Banks has a tax lien recorded at 21553 Newcastle Rd — Holland’s address. This confirms cohabitation: Banks uses Holland’s address for tax purposes while listing 1968 Severn as his “primary residence” on other filings.

Wayne County ROD records show Banks at both addresses across a 15-year period.

Verify

  • Wayne ROD: 21553 Newcastle Rd — QCD #2007402847 (Banks → Banks + Holland JTWRS, $1, Jun 2007)
  • Wayne ROD: 1968 Severn Rd — QCD #2024223261 (Banks → Trust, Aug 2024)
  • Wayne ROD: Trust Certificate #2025307266 (Holland as 1st Successor Trustee, Nov 2025)
  • PACER E.D. Mich: Cases 09-46072-swr and 14-51632-mar (compare Schedule A)
  • 🏛️ LARA MiBusiness — Entity 803294855 (Purpose Foundation)
  • 🏛️ LARA MiBusiness — Entity 803295082 (Purpose Group LLC)
  • 🏛️ MDOC OTIS — MDOC #443789

All sources are public records. The property chain is verifiable at the Wayne County Register of Deeds. The bankruptcy concealment is verifiable by comparing Holland’s sworn schedules (PACER) with the deed (#2007402847) that remained on file throughout both proceedings.
